# 40 — THE DOCUMENT

A library of the shape Insanity_Loom reads: every section numbered, cited by its number.

## 40.6 — THE WIKI

Links between whispers and sections; backlinks; search.

### 40.6.2 — Links between whispers

A link to another whisper carries that whisper's file name, written as a browser writes an address. It is relative,
so the same link works in Insanity_Loom and in a browser opening the file.

### 40.6.9 — What points here

The whispers that link to the one open, and which of its sections each points into.
